bagPolicy.summary: For the October 2026 Usher and Chris Brown show, the official event page allows clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear bags and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Medical items may be inspected; backpacks, fanny packs and diaper bags are prohibited.
